items.title: Launch HN: Laminar (YC S24) – RL-trained model that finds errors in agent traces
items.excerpt: Hi HN, we’re Robert and Din from Laminar ( https://laminar.sh ). We’ve been building open-source observability for AI agents since 2024. Recently, we released flow-1, a model trained with RL to find errors in agent traces. On our benchmark ( https://laminar.sh/blog/flow-1 ), it matches GPT-6-sol in detection quality while being 23x cheaper. This makes it affordable to analyze every production agent trace, without sampling. Here’s a one-minute walkthrough:  https://youtu.be/KJa3h6ZJNLQ  We also put together a post with example traces and analyses from flow-1 and other models:  https://laminar.s
